1.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_001
1.description: Have you come here to share a heroic yarn with me, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Please, do go on─you have my rapt attention.

4.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_002
4.description: Oh, have you come just to say hello? I appreciate the gesture, to be sure, just as I appreciate that you are a busy <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03>. Even so, I do hope you find time in the future to regale me with a tale or two.

5.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_003
5.description: ...Ah, I understand. You have no tales worth telling─yet, that is. I know for certain 'tis but a matter of time until you are thrust into the heart of matters most dramatic.

6.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_004
6.description: Fortunately, the denizens of this city are great lovers of tall tales and thrilling verse. They simply cannot hear enough of your exploits, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Thank you for being my ever-dependable muse.

7.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_005
7.description: So, what have you brought for me today?

8.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_006
8.description: You did battle with Valigarmanda!? The tural vidraal of legend, dubbed the Skyruin, who ruled the heavens by beak and talon. Many are the legends of this beast among beasts, but I would wager the telling of your battle is more thrilling than the most harrowing tales!

9.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_007
9.description: By the hands of a devious scoundrel was the seal put in place by Gulool Ja Ja broken, and thus was the living calamity unleashed again upon the world...only to be struck down by Wuk Lamat and her mighty companion!

10.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_008
10.description: This glimpse into the events of the rite of succession shall provide me with more than enough inspiration for my next song. Thank you for sharing it with me, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

11.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_009
11.description: By the by, do you know the meaning of the term “tural vidraal”?

12.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_010
12.description: In the language of the Mamool Ja, it means “that which clings to the earth.” A fitting description for beings powerful enough to claim an entire continent as their territory. And Valigarmanda was said to be the most formidable among them.

13.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_011
13.description: Though you emerged victorious, the fiend was but recently roused from slumber. What do you suppose would have happened had Valigarmanda been given sufficient time to regain its strength?

14.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_012
14.description: Hah, such questions are why we have imaginations, yes? And imagine I shall... The mightiest heroes of Etheirys matched against the full fury of Valigarmanda. A story for the ages!

15.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_020
15.description: So, what have you brought for me today?

16.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_021
16.description: Ah, the final moments of the former Dawnservant's firstborn. His story gives rise to a complex mixture of emotions, and it would be insulting to call it something so trite as an adventurous tale.

17.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_022
17.description: As the only true son of Gulool Ja Ja, he doubtless felt a heavy burden of responsibility to be deemed worthy of succeeding his father. This weight was likely made all the more stifling by the fact he had but one head.

18.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_023
18.description: And so he sought great power to make up for his perceived shortcomings. Yet he could never quite live up to the expectations he set for himself, and in his blind pursuit, he stepped upon a crooked path...

19.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_024
19.description: For thirty long years did he keep company with anger in that dome... Yet no amount of anguish can justify the countless lives he stole.

20.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_025
20.description: You know what I believe, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? I believe the moment Zoraal Ja killed his own father, whose admiration he fought so hard to win, his life lost all meaning.

21.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_026
21.description: His sins cannot be forgiven, 'tis true. Yet his story is a tragic one, and I suspect each of us can see parts of ourselves reflected within it.

22.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_027
22.description: Thank you for sharing it with me. A dark shadow loomed over the rite of succession, and we would do best not to forget he who cast it.

23.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_028
23.description: While many will view Zoraal Ja as a murderer and tyrant, reducing him to a mindless villain will blunt the impact of the lessons we can learn from his fate. This is a tale that must be told with great care...

24.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_030
24.description: So, what have you brought for me today?

25.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_031
25.description: The trials and tribulations of Queen Sphene, who was confronted with many a difficult decision as she sought to protect the citizens of her nation, Alexandria...

26.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_032
26.description: In that realm, people regard souls as merely a resource. And when they die, the aether of their memories is used to create the Endless, simulacra of the departed that can only be sustained with life force harvested from the living...

27.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_033
27.description: Being so very different from what we know, such a way of life is difficult for us to accept. Indeed, it seemed only inevitable that you should come into conflict with Sphene.

28.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_034
28.description: She herself was not among the living, but an entity brought forth to fulfill a certain objective. And therein, I believe, lay the root of this tale's tragedy.

29.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_035
29.description: Recreated from the noblest of souls though she was, she was helpless to defy the purpose to which she had been bound: protecting the Endless no matter the cost.

30.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_036
30.description: Thus did she continue on her destructive path, though she knew it led only to a dead end.

31.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_037
31.description: A question if you may, my friend. Deep in your heart, do you believe that the Sphene whom you met was alive?

33.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_A5_000_002
33.description: She was alive, in her own way.

34.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_A5_000_003
34.description: Though she was many things, she wasn't alive.

36.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_038
36.description: So you think that. Even with the knowledge that her existence differed from the living, you hold that she was alive...

37.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_039
37.description: I see. Indeed, her existence differed greatly from the living. There is no changing that fact.

38.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_040
38.description: I see. Though her existence differed much from the living, precisely what does it mean to be alive? 'Tis no easy thing to define.

39.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_041
39.description: I thank you for your honest answer. I shall take it to heart.

40.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_042
40.description: For my part, whether or not she was possessed of life, I believe that there existed an individual called Sphene, who cared deeply for her people. Who heard the voices of her people, felt as they did, and thought only for their welfare.

41.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_043
41.description: That is why, at battle's end, she returned as the gentle soul you knew.

42.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_044
42.description: But here, a thought fills me with dread. What if that soul failed to return, and the fearsome entity she had become continued its relentless onslaught?

43.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_045
43.description: Might it have succeeded in its objective, and plundered life force from other realities at the cost of untold destruction...? Of such a possibility shall I sing, that we might give thanks for the path we were mercifully spared.

44.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_046
44.description: By golden light two rulers walked,<hex:02100103>Their paths in conflict lying.♪<hex:02100103>One bound to slay, one sworn to save,<hex:02100103>They forged ahead untiring.♪<hex:02100103>

45.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_047
45.description: The mem'ries of departed days,<hex:02100103>Endure as fate and fetters.♪<hex:02100103>For keepers staunch a blessed warmth,<hex:02100103>Oblivion for the breakers.♪

46.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_SYSTEM_000_98
46.description: Chaotic alliance raids pit up to twenty-four adventurers against a fearsome foe who has been made even more powerful than before.

47.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_Q2_000_99
47.description: Do you wish to unlock the Cloud of Darkness (Chaotic)?

48.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_100
48.description: Ah, that reminds me. Some days ago, I had the pleasure of meeting your good friend G'raha Tia.

49.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_101
49.description: He approached me, wondering if he had seen me elsewhere before, and so I told him about my endeavors in verse.

50.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_102
50.description: Taking an interest in my work, he invited me to join him at Xbalyav Ty'e, where we discussed tales of heroism over tacos and churrasco.

51.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_103
51.description: 'Twas then that he shared a story that is especially close to his heart.

52.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_104
52.description: The fellowship of NOAH's foray into the Crystal Tower... You played a vital role in it, did you not?

53.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_105
53.description: Together with more than a score of your fellows, you triumphed over numerous formidable foes to secure the structure.

54.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_106
54.description: How do you recall the experience, pray? As adventurers typically work in small groups, I daresay it felt quite different to be part of a large contingent.

57.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_A3_000_109
57.description: I may have been a little nervous...

58.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_A3_000_110
58.description: I just played it by ear.

59.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_111
59.description: Haha, you truly are fearless, my friend!

60.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_112
60.description: Truly? I would not have expected that!

61.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_113
61.description: Hehe, I do favor such an approach myself.

62.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_114
62.description: Now, I can only speak as an observer, but I imagine it must be uniquely satisfying to sally forth as a member of a great collective to accomplish tremendous feats.

63.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_115
63.description: And to defeat the dreaded Cloud of Darkness is a tremendous feat indeed.

64.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_116
64.description: She is a ruler among her kind, occupying the highest rung of the hierarchy of voidsent.

65.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_117
65.description: Full oft has she left her mark upon mankind's history, not least of all when she forged a pact with Emperor Xande.

66.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_118
66.description: And according to records, she employed powerful magicks the likes of which defied mortal comprehension.

69.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_A4_000_121
69.description: Didn't she use beams and...more beams?

70.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_122
70.description: Hmm... It may well be that you saw merely one aspect of the Cloud of Darkness.

71.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_123
71.description: As I understand it, voidsent are changeable beings, their forms dependent on factors such as the aether at their disposal. Another time, and you may have faced a somewhat different foe.

72.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_124
72.description: 'Tis an intriguing possibility to consider, would you not agree?

73.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_125
73.description: ...So together with your comrade Ryne, you gave rise to a being based upon the Cloud of Darkness?

74.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_126
74.description: A familiar yet distinct entity shaped by your combined impressions of the voidsent queen...

75.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_127
75.description: That gives me an idea! I shall compose a song about the <hex:021A020203>true<hex:021A020103> Cloud of Darkness as I imagine her, for which I shall draw inspiration from your account!

76.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_128
76.description: 'Tis an intriguing possibility to consider...and it gives me an idea!

77.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_129
77.description: I shall compose a song about the <hex:021A020203>true<hex:021A020103> Cloud of Darkness as I imagine her, for which I shall draw inspiration from your account!

79.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_131
79.description: When Light and Dark as one become,<hex:02100103>to oblivion all to cast,♪<hex:02100103>A champion dauntless shall arise,<hex:02100103>to cleave them at the last.♪

80.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_132
80.description: Into their hands entrusted be,<hex:02100103>the hopes of all mankind,♪<hex:02100103>Upon the wind eternal borne,<hex:02100103>a bright and shining sign.♪

81.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_133
81.description: The time is come, so go you forth,<hex:02100103>unto the battlefield.♪<hex:02100103>The final confrontation looms,<hex:02100103>To test your blade and shield.♪

82.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_134
82.description: Though it may pale in comparison to facing the Cloud of Darkness, it gave me great satisfaction to compose these verses. And should they give you satisfaction as well, then naught would please me more!

83.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_200
83.description: So, what have you brought for me today?

84.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_201
84.description: Well now, that is quite a tremendous tale... If I may, I shall attempt to recount it in my own words, the better to reflect upon the events for song.

85.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_202
85.description: A century past, the hero Ardbert fought and felled the Ascian Mitron. By the power of Light, the villain's body was transformed into Eden, the first sin eater, who unleashed the Flood of Light that engulfed the First.

86.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_203
86.description: Despite being locked in a stupor, Mitron mustered the strength to call from the prison that was his vessel, in the desperate hope of reaching his fallen comrade, Loghrif. And reach Loghrif he finally did, in her reincarnated form as the maiden Gaia.

87.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_204
87.description: From a young age, Gaia had heard Mitron's voice in her mind. She referred to it as “the faerie,” and there were times when it even took over her consciousness.

88.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_205
88.description: And be it by chance or by fate, Eden's subsequent awakening by Ryne, the Oracle of Light, led to Gaia's appearance in the Empty, where the two maidens first encountered each other.

89.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_206
89.description: At length, Mitron restored Loghrif's memories in Gaia, and the two Ascians returned once more. But in no small part due to your valor, the worst was prevented from coming to pass...

90.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_207
90.description: 'Tis truly a stirring tale, and no moment of it more so than when Gaia lay on the verge of being erased. How beautiful to imagine that her memories of Ryne served as an anchor that kept her from fading away.

91.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_208
91.description: Yet as perfectly as that unfolded, I cannot help but wonder what might have happened if something else had gone awry. For instance, in the moment that Ryne roused Eden, what if Mitron had likewise reached out and interfered...?

92.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_209
92.description: Yes, I believe I have the makings of a song. One that speaks of a future that was not, yet may very well have been...

93.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_210
93.description: A villain dark a gaol did break,<hex:02100103>The Light to liberate.♪<hex:02100103>A maiden pure her eyes unsure,<hex:02100103>He sought to change her fate.♪

94.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_211
94.description: Undying soul a gaol did flee,<hex:02100103>The Dark to stir awake.♪<hex:02100103>A maiden lost to find once more,<hex:02100103>And good a promise make.♪

95.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_212
95.description: The First, a reflection that lay on the verge of annihilation by Light... Though I but speculate, many a tale must lie untold that steered its course.

96.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_213
96.description: As you tell it, the immortal Ascians were behind the calamities that befell the reflections.

97.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_214
97.description: If so, is it not a possibility that they, too, were responsible for the Flood of Light?

98.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_215
98.description: The Flood was then forestalled by the Oracle of Light, Minfilia, whose power was inherited by maidens after her. Souls who, by virtue of their gift, were destined to die fighting the sin eaters.

99.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_216
99.description: Theirs was a cruel path, but I wish to believe that they did not walk it alone. That someone stood with them, who sought to break the tragic wheel of fate.

100.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_217
100.description: Said someone might have been like them in some ways, yet the complete opposite in others. For instance...a maiden of like age, but who has ties to the Ascians─an Oracle of Darkness.

101.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_218
101.description: Yes, I believe I have the makings of a song. One that speaks of legacies inherited and destinies reshaped...

102.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_300
102.description: So, what have you brought for me today?

103.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_301
103.description: Zelenia Triantafylli, second-in-command of Alexandria's royal knights... Chivalry is a timeless subject, indeed! Long has it been the inspiration for some of our most beloved tales.

104.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_302
104.description: Stirring epics of heroes who give every onze of their strength to defend their charge. Some recount heart-wrenching tragedies of the disgraced, who live bearing the burden of failure, while others tell of selfless figures who pay the ultimate price for their virtue.

105.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_303
105.description: These yarns captivate listeners because they venture beneath the celebrated image of the gallant knight, providing a glimpse of a person ordinary and flawed. A person not unlike you or I.

106.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_304
106.description: And while 'tis plain that as captured in the queen's memory, Zelenia was a devoted subject, hers is certainly a tale driven by more than mere loyalty. After all, a life lived by the sword must inevitably be stained with crimson.

107.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_305
107.description: The queen viewed her as a stalwart guardian, and ever found comfort behind her imposing form. Yet from that position, Sphene could not see the steely gaze with which Zelenia regarded her foes, nor feel the rage that burned within her heart.

108.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_306
108.description: And I imagine the chaos of battle, as well, appeared quite differently from each of their perspectives. A fascinating duality, perhaps best illustrated with a song...

109.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_307
109.description: A steadfast blade she wields for me,<hex:02100103>Her gaze upon the foe.♪<hex:02100103>In mem'ries deep that form engraved,<hex:02100103>Her knightly pose just so.♪

110.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_308
110.description: All threats that rise against my liege,<hex:02100103>With sword and spell struck down.♪<hex:02100103>Deservéd death awaits the fools,<hex:02100103>Who dare assail the crown.♪

111.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_309
111.description: No rose is without thorns. Zelenia was doubtless an honorable fighter and protector, yet that selfsame honor fueled the merciless fury she unleashed upon the enemies of the royal family.

112.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_310
112.description: How would you have fared had such fury marked Queen Sphene's memories? Would you have bested Zelenia, or would her thorns have left you bloodied?

113.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_400
113.description: So, what have you brought for me today?

114.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_401
114.description: Ah, you speak of Calyx, genius born of a bygone era, and the primal he nourished upon a feast of mortal terror...

115.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_402
115.description: Powerful was the onset of fear felt by a people who had long escaped death's mournful memories. And powerful was the entity which that fear begat.

116.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_403
116.description: Yet would Calyx not have nurtured that selfsame dread since the moment of his birth?

117.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_404
117.description: Was he not fated to succumb to his childhood malady ere he reached his full growth?

118.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_405
118.description: The chirping insects which lulled him to sleep in the evening. The birdsong which called him awake come the morn... Such sounds must have been as chalk on a slate, marking the passage of his dwindling days.

119.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_406
119.description: Surely 'twas Calyx himself, more than any other, who nurtured the deepest, darkest fear of death.

120.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_407
120.description: Dwelling upon that beleaguered heart, I am inspired to sing of the horror it may have spawned...

121.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_408
121.description: Forget thee not the hand of death,<hex:02100103>For all shall feel its grip.♪<hex:02100103>At queenly feet lay down thy fears,<hex:02100103>Dark prayer be on thy lip.♪

122.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_409
122.description: Forget thee not the hand of death,<hex:02100103>For even Endless end.♪<hex:02100103>Where queen awoke stoke thee thy hope,<hex:02100103>'Pon heels of Light ascend.♪

123.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_500
123.description: So, what have you brought for me today?

124.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_501
124.description: Arkveld, the white wanderer from a faraway world... I daresay that the word “hunt” suffices not to capture your struggle with the creature.

125.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_502
125.description: Intrigued though am I by the device described in the Felyne's tale, what strikes me most of all is the nature of this Guardian. That is, its predilection for energy.

126.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_503
126.description: In the animal kingdom, a predator devours other beasts for its survival. Yet Arkveld appeared not to be driven by this fundamental need.

127.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_504
127.description: Instead, it harbored an extreme obsession for aether─an obsession which saw it slaughter the beasts of Shaaloani to assert dominance over its newfound realm.

128.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_505
128.description: In response, the Serpentlord rose up to face this interloper, as if the land itself wished to repel a common threat.

129.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_506
129.description: Without such resistance─and your timely intervention─there is no telling how grave a threat Arkveld might have become.

130.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_507
130.description: Finding itself in an unfamiliar land, the Guardian merely did what its instincts bade it do. Were I to render such a savage life in verse, it might go thus...

131.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_508
131.description: In silv'ry coat its body cloaked,<hex:02100103>From distant world it came.♪<hex:02100103>On reddened earth the Guardian roamed,<hex:02100103>The lives of foes to claim.♪

132.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_509
132.description: In hunger deep was locked this beast,<hex:02100103>In silv'ry chains entwined.♪<hex:02100103>To conquer all its savage fate,<hex:02100103>New paradise to find.♪

133.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_600
133.description: So, what have you brought for me today?

134.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_601
134.description: A man-made horror thundering across a levin-struck plain...

135.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_602
135.description: ...Kingdoms it was to vanquish now vanished in all but name.

136.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_603
136.description: With even the battlefields they were born to besiege reduced to ash, the locomotive and its fearsome cargo were condemned to run hither and thither along the rails till time's end.

137.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_604
137.description: One wonders how the entity housed within perceived its fate.

138.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_605
138.description: Did its union with the train allow it to take joy in the simple embrace of speed? Had it an innate love of bloodshed, the thrill of each violent encounter may have driven it ever faster in search of foes to slaughter.

139.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_606
139.description: Or was it fueled by belief that those tracks would, someday, deliver it home? Perhaps it was unable to understand─or accept─that Lindblum and its people were no more...

140.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_607
140.description: I should like to see it reunited with those who created it, if only in song. Let the melody carry it where steel did not...

141.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_608
141.description: O the wild charge it made!<hex:02100103>Beasts aboard and wheels ablaze,♪<hex:02100103>Entrusted with a nation's fate,<hex:02100103>'Pon glory fixed its gaze...♪

142.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_609
142.description: When that kingdom too was razed,<hex:02100103>With nowhere left to go,♪<hex:02100103>O the wild charge it made!<hex:02100103>And ne'er did it slow...♪

143.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_700
143.description: So, what have you brought for me today?

144.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_701
144.description: Ah, Enuo... That dread denizen of the depths who sought out the voidgate and thence the Source.

145.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_702
145.description: Having already endured a deathless eternity in the void, it is not inconceivable they would have been content to merely preside over their realm without end.

146.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_703
146.description: Yet perhaps our light-filled world presented such a loathsome affront as to beckon Enuo from the dark, intent on rendering all to naught. Of course, we can but speculate upon their true designs...

147.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_704
147.description: For your unforeseen arrival upon the red moon laid any such vengeful plans to rest. It is fitting that your companion Zero was there by your side as the killing blow was struck─her name evoking new beginnings as it does.

148.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_705
148.description: Were it not for that fateful reunion, mayhap all Light would be enveloped in Darkness, all life trapped within the ceaseless void.

149.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_706
149.description: A world unmade... 'Tis a paradoxical notion, but one I nonetheless feel compelled to put to song.

150.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_707
150.description: In darkest depths did they abide,<hex:02100103>Cursed to lurk undying.♪<hex:02100103>Life and Light did they decry,<hex:02100103>The void's dread power rising.♪

151.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_708
151.description: By golden path was ingress made,<hex:02100103>Will and might prevailing.♪<hex:02100103>Cleaving through that bleak domain,<hex:02100103>The void's dread power failing.♪

152.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_709
152.description: Have you ever pondered how your life might have unfolded had you been born unto that endless dark expanse?

153.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_800
153.description: You are always so generous with your time and tales of adventure, but today I would offer you a most curious tale shared with me in passing on a recent excursion.

154.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_801
154.description: A sprightly, young adventurer was relaxing at an inn after a laborious day's journey, ready to retire for the evening.

155.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_802
155.description: No sooner did he enter his room than he found himself in an altogether different space. What's more, he was not alone.

156.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_803
156.description: Seven other adventurers stood at the ready beside him, drawing their weapons as they exchanged pleasantries.

157.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_804
157.description: What stood before them was a rather peculiar mage he described as putting the <hex:021A020203>mad<hex:021A020103> in madcap.

158.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_805
158.description: A pitched battle then ensued, the echoes of maniacal laughter filling the air as the harlequin fiend flung spell after spell.

159.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_806
159.description: It seemed the would-be jester was toying with them, its repertoire of tricks and traps seemingly inexhaustible.

160.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_807
160.description: Even so, the adventurers did not falter, and after a grueling struggle, they would eventually prove victorious.

161.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_808
161.description: Their relief was palpable. But no sooner had they split their hard-earned spoils than he found himself back at the inn.

162.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_809
162.description: A truly inexplicable-yet-fascinating encounter, would you not agree?

163.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_810
163.description: Was it a dream? Or perhaps a wild fabrication? I have played audience to many a tale, both tall and true, yet I cannot help but feel the fool seeking the truth behind this particular story.

165.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_A5_000_812
165.description: A fascinating tale in any case.

166.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_A5_000_813
166.description: Eh, I've had stranger things happen.

168.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_815
168.description: Indeed. Seemingly absurd, and yet it sets my mind to racing all the same.

169.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_816
169.description: Hah, I suppose you have shared with me no few stories of events that defy explanation.

170.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_817
170.description: Even so, such seemingly outlandish stories set my mind to racing all the same.

171.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_818
171.description: Yet something in your eyes bespeaks a bond between you and this adventurer. If I did not know better, I might surmise you joined him on this curious venture...

172.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_819
172.description: Am I right? Is that the way of it?

173.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_820
173.description: If you are unwilling to tell me, then I shan't pry... Would that I could bear witness to such fierce battle. The very thought of it sets my mind to racing.

174.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_821
174.description: Yes, I do believe a song is taking shape in my mind. Of breathtaking, death-defying feats of heroism.

175.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_822
175.description: A distant land, in a distant age,<hex:02100103>Sundered by this harlequin mage.♪<hex:02100103>Its rubble stacked to build a tower,<hex:02100103>Stronghold for his twisted power.♪<hex:02100103>

176.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_823
176.description: A dark world suffering ceaseless plight,<hex:02100103>No solace found in judgment's light.♪<hex:02100103>And thus heroes ventured far and wide<hex:02100103>In search of friends to turn the tide.♪

177.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_824
177.description: I daresay this motley mage and I are alike in at least one regard─a flair for creative flourishes in our art. With every telling of our stories, every rendition of our songs, we find new meaning. Thus are no two performances ever the same.

178.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_825
178.description: Of course, there can be no performance without an audience. As their participation often elicits unexpected changes of course, it falls to us to take these diversions in stride—our reward an eruption of praise and applause.

179.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70WANDERINGMINSTREL_00897_WANDERINGMINSTREL_000_826
179.description: Does this adventurer have what it takes to steal the show, I wonder...
